speaker: Kael
text: Form up, Emberwing! The whole academy's watching — let's give them something worth the seats.

speaker: Serra
text: Watch your footing, Kai. Tidemark holds the fort, and the tide does not part for sparks.

speaker: Corin
text: Do carry on, both of you. Thornrook finds it terribly instructive when rivals blunt each other's blades for free.

speaker: Kai
text: Two weeks ago I foraged mushrooms for a living. Now the whole academy wants to watch me take a fort. ...Fine. Serra's on the hill — eyes northeast.

speaker: Brenna
text: Then the orders are simple. Reach Lady Serra and defeat her — or rout every Tidemark student on the field.

speaker: Wren
text: And it's a mock battle — nobody dies today. Yield if you must; I'll patch everything else.

speaker: Kai
text: Stay close. Watch each other's backs. ...Alright, Emberwing. Advance.
